finding: There is no separate analytic capsule-AO producer. The shipped ShadowReceiver consumes the VisibilitySH screen buffer plus its log-SH LUT and lerps the shaded result toward _CapsuleAoColor by the decoded occlusion. The producer the manifest calls missing is the already-implemented VisibilitySH producer.

t4.channel_evidence: B and A are zero across all 256 texels, so sampling zw would be degenerate; R and G carry the rising coefficient curve. This independently confirms the xy read implied by the t4.zxyw swizzle

cb4[3].xy.note: the earlier 1/4.6 = 0.2173913 consistency bound was close but wrong by about 1.5 percent; it was recorded as a bound rather than substituted as a value, and the recovered constant replaces it

recovered_equation: else: halve sh while length(sh.yzw) > 4.6, counting the halvings
repeat the halving count: band = SH self-product scaled by 0.282095
algorithm: Spherical-harmonic exponentiation of a log-space visibility SH. The buffer holds accumulated log occlusion; the receiver evaluates exp(SH) as (exp(SH / 2^n))^(2^n), which is why it halves until the linear magnitude falls under the threshold, applies the LUT once, and then repeats the SH self-product exactly n times.

log_exponent_scale.derivation: Y00 * log2(e) = 0.40697675715277876. The DXBC exp opcode is base 2, so exp2(sh.x * 0.406977) is exactly exp(Y00 * sh.x), the DC term of the SH exponentiation

cb4_3_constraint: cb4[3].xy maps the post-normalisation magnitude length(sh.yzw) into the LUT's [0,1] domain, since the result is quantised as (x*255+0.5)/256. The halving loop bounds that magnitude at the 4.6 threshold, so a scale of 1/4.6 with zero bias is consistent with the observed domain. That is a consistency bound, not a recovered value, and must not be substituted for one.

capsule_set_validation.detail: Retail serialises the capsules as HGCapsuleShadowHelper m_capsuleShadowContainers, ten per actor. Wulfa matches the lab on every height, radius, intensity, offset and rotation to a worst absolute delta of 5e-15; Zhuangfy matches to about 1e-7 except one upper-arm capsule at 0.162 degrees, and retail has twenty variants carrying that signature, so that is variant selection rather than an error.
capsule_set_validation.note: isFoot is set on exactly the two foot capsules and the lab ignores it. The retail helper also binds fourteen skeleton joints including Wrist_R/L and ToesEnd_R/L, which are capsule endpoints rather than additional capsules; the ten-capsule count is correct.
